text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 23, 2025) for 10 Kinsdale Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 12, 2025) for 10 Kinsdale Boulevard, Folder Number: 25 265603 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2026, to the satisfaction of the City.
